note: Hand-labelled expected document kinds, executed flags and period ends, written before any guess_kind exists. Labels come from the file name and what pages 1-3 show; the guess sees pages[:3] as the launcher's _pages yields them (PDF pages, xlsx sheets, 12,000-char chunks for text/CSV/XML, 3,000-char rows for HTML whose first line 'Visible text of <file name>' is ignored). Real paths are repo-relative and read in place. Synthetic .txt fixtures: line 1 is the banner 'SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not issuer evidence' and is not page text; pages are separated by a line '=== PAGE ==='; the text before the first separator is page 1; the file name is the name given to guess_kind. executed is true only for an explicit execution mark (or for the file name where it says so and nothing contradicts it), false only for an explicit draft mark, else null. period_end only for a financial_report whose cover states the period end.
